Container.Name: Youtarr-Feed
Container.Overview: Mobile-first subscription feed for Youtarr. Browse channels, play local videos, start missing downloads, save single video links, and sync watch progress server-side.
Container.Requires: A reachable Youtarr instance. A Youtarr username and password are required for the subscription feed unless you use a session token.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port where Youtarr Feed is reachable through your Unraid server.

Config.Name: Youtarr URL
Config.Description: Internal Youtarr address reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Youtarr Username
Config.Description: Youtarr username. Not needed when using a session token.

Config.Name: Youtarr Password
Config.Description: Youtarr password. Kept only as a protected server-side container setting on Unraid.

Config.Name: Youtarr API Key
Config.Description: Optional Youtarr API key for download commands. Feed access still needs login credentials or a session token.

Config.Name: YouTube API Key
Config.Description: Optional fallback for exact YouTube publishedAt timestamps in Youtarr Feed. Prefer setting this key in Youtarr itself first; use this only if Youtarr still returns date-only values.

Config.Name: Youtarr Session Token
Config.Description: Alternative to username and password. Sessions can expire.

Config.Name: Youtarr Authentication Disabled
Config.Description: Set to true only if authentication is intentionally disabled in your Youtarr installation.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for server-side watch progress, Continue Watching, feed cache, and single videos.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal container location for persistent app data. Keep this set to /data.

Config.Name: Feed Cache TTL
Config.Description: Number of seconds feed and local-video overviews are cached server-side. Default is 300 for fast app starts without data staying stale for too long.

Config.Name: Youtarr Media Path
Config.Description: Same host folder as Youtarr's output/download folder. Read-write is required when Youtarr Feed should clean up dual-quality files after delete.

Config.Name: Media Directory
Config.Description: Internal container location of the Youtarr media mount. Keep this equal to the container path above.

Config.Name: Delete Local Media Files
Config.Description: Set to true to delete every local media file matching the same YouTube video ID after Youtarr confirms a delete. Requires the media path to be mounted read-write.

Config.Name: Dual Quality Downloads
Config.Description: Set to true to ask Youtarr for a second 1080p copy when Youtarr Feed starts a download. The player shows Original/1080p only when both files exist.

Config.Name: Primary Download Resolution
Config.Description: Optional resolution override for the primary/original download. Leave empty to use Youtarr channel/global quality. Set 2160 only if you want this app to force the primary download toward 4K.

Config.Name: Secondary Download Resolution
Config.Description: Resolution for the second dual-quality copy. Defaults to 1080.

Config.Name: Secondary Download Subfolder
Config.Description: Subfolder for the second copy so it does not overwrite the original. Youtarr Feed scans the media mount recursively.

Config.Name: Enable Apple Transcoding
Config.Description: Set to true to prepare Apple-compatible files with ffmpeg for iPhone, iPad, Safari, and AirPlay when high-resolution local files are not H.264/AAC compatible.

Config.Name: Transcode Acceleration
Config.Description: Use vaapi for Intel Quick Sync. Use software only if no hardware acceleration is available.

Config.Name: Transcode Device
Config.Description: VAAPI render device inside the container, usually /dev/dri/renderD128.

Config.Name: Intel Quick Sync Device
Config.Description: Optional device mapping for Intel Quick Sync / VAAPI transcoding. Required when Apple transcoding is enabled with vaapi.

Config.Name: Transcode Output Mode
Config.Description: Use file to create reusable compatible MP4 files. Use hls only for the older temporary HLS mode.

Config.Name: Transcode Minimum Height
Config.Description: Only transcode videos at this height or higher. Default 1440 means 1440p and 4K are prepared while 1080p is skipped. Set 0 to allow all.

Config.Name: Transcode Playback Mode
Config.Description: HLS mode only. Use vod to wait for a finite HLS playlist and avoid Apple's Live Broadcast label. Use fast to start playback while HLS is still being generated.

Config.Name: Transcode Video Bitrate
Config.Description: Target H.264 video bitrate for Apple-compatible output when software transcoding is used.

Config.Name: Transcode VAAPI Quality
Config.Description: Quality value for VAAPI CQP mode. Lower is higher quality and larger output. Default is 20; use 18 for higher quality if storage is not important.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Optional. Internal Plex address for a library scan after a download completes.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Optional Plex token. Used server-side only and never sent to your phone.

Config.Name: Plex Library ID
Config.Description: Optional numeric ID of your Youtarr library in Plex.
